spans.s:
The affix अण् comes in the sense of a descendant after the words शिव etc.

Terms: अण्

The affix तातिल् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the words 1. शिव 2. शम् and 3. अरिष्ट in the Genitive 6th-Case in construction when the sense is 'he does'.

Terms: तातिल्

The ष् change may take place optionally in the सिव् and the rest (of the last sūtra) even when the augment अ intervenes between the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) परि , नि and वि and the verb.

Terms: षत्व change
